classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This unit is a contemporary administrative record from the Helvetic Republic's Ministry of War, documenting officer appointment procedures.
classification.resume: This is a register listing applications for officer positions in the Helvetic Republic's half-brigades for the year 1798, organized by canton. It includes details on applicants' names, ages, origins, qualifications, references, and requests, as well as any appointments made. The document serves as an administrative record of military staffing during the Helvetic Republic.
